name: switch
summary: Switches a group between one column and one complete row.

agent.useWhen: A group should stack below a container width and become one complete row above it.
agent.avoidWhen: Items should wrap independently or form a card grid; use Cluster or Grid.

invariants: Child source order is preserved at every size.
Row expansion occurs at the chosen container boundary; never expands immediately.
Neutral wrappers add no landmarks, controls, scripts, routes, or commands.
